summary: Alder Studio team members use an authenticated multi-route operations dashboard to create durable projects and tasks, assign owners, update task status, filter work views, manage roles, view analytics, and recover changes after reload.

journeys.title: A signed-in team member creates a project, adds a task, updates the task, and recovers the change after reload

steps.action: open the projects page as an authenticated team member
steps.expect: the Alder Studio Projects heading, New Project button, and project list area are visible

steps.action: create a new project with a client, owner, target date, and active status
steps.expect: the created project appears in the project list with its title, client, owner, target date, and Active status

steps.action: open the created project detail page
steps.expect: the project detail page shows the project title, task section, and Add Task button

steps.action: create a task for the project with a title, owner, priority, due date, and To Do status
steps.expect: the new task is visible in the project task list with its owner, priority, due date, and To Do status badge

steps.action: change the task status to In Progress
steps.expect: the task row immediately shows an In Progress status badge

steps.action: reload the project detail page
steps.expect: the same project and task are still visible and the task still shows In Progress

acceptance: a project created in the browser is still visible after a full page reload
a task created under that project is still visible after a full page reload
a task status update to In Progress survives a full page reload

journeys.title: A team member filters board and list views to find matching tasks

steps.action: open the board page as an authenticated team member
steps.expect: the board view shows columns for To Do, In Progress, Review, Blocked, and Done

steps.action: filter the board by a non-default status and owner
steps.expect: only task cards matching To Do status and Ada Morgan as owner are visible, and a visible filter summary names To Do and Ada Morgan

steps.action: open the task list page
steps.expect: the list view shows task rows and search and filter controls

steps.action: search the list for a matching task title while leaving status at the all-statuses sentinel
steps.expect: the task list shows at least one row containing Kickoff and no rows that omit the word Kickoff

steps.action: clear all filters
steps.expect: the filter summary disappears and the full task list is visible again

acceptance: board filters visibly hide tasks that do not match the selected status and owner
list search visibly returns only rows matching the entered search text
clearing filters restores unfiltered board or list results

journeys.title: A team member views an analytics summary for current durable project and task data

steps.action: open the analytics page as an authenticated team member
steps.expect: the Analytics Summary heading and metric cards are visible

steps.action: load the current summary
steps.expect: metric cards show total projects, total tasks, completed tasks, blocked tasks, overdue tasks, and completion rate

steps.action: open the status breakdown section
steps.expect: a visible breakdown lists counts for To Do, In Progress, Review, Blocked, and Done

steps.action: reload the analytics page
steps.expect: the same metric cards are recalculated from saved projects and tasks and remain visible after reload

acceptance: analytics shows numeric totals for saved projects and tasks
status breakdown displays a count for each supported task status
analytics remains available after a page reload

journeys.title: An administrator changes a team member role

steps.action: open the administrator page as an authenticated administrator
steps.expect: the Team Administration heading, members table, and role controls are visible

steps.action: select a member row to edit
steps.expect: the selected member row is highlighted and its current role is displayed

steps.action: change the selected member role to Administrator
steps.expect: the selected row shows an Administrator role badge and a saved confirmation message

steps.action: reload the administrator page
steps.expect: the same member still shows the Administrator role badge after reload

acceptance: an administrator can see and use role controls
a changed member role is visible immediately after saving
a changed member role persists after reload

journeys.title: A signed-in non-administrator is blocked from administrator-only controls

steps.action: open the administrator page as an authenticated member without administrator role
steps.expect: an Access denied message is visible and member role editing controls are not visible

steps.action: open the projects page as the same member
steps.expect: the project dashboard is visible and the member can see project and task navigation

acceptance: non-administrator members cannot see role editing controls
non-administrator members can still access operational project and task pages

routes.name: Sign In
routes.purpose: allows Alder Studio team members to authenticate with platform email and password authentication

routes.name: Projects
routes.purpose: shows saved projects and provides the create project workflow

routes.name: Project Detail
routes.purpose: shows one saved project and its saved tasks, with controls to create tasks and update task details

routes.name: Board
routes.purpose: shows saved tasks grouped by status with status and owner filters

routes.name: Task List
routes.purpose: shows a searchable and filterable table of saved tasks across projects

routes.name: Analytics
routes.purpose: shows calculated project and task summary metrics from durable data

routes.name: Team Administration
routes.purpose: allows administrators to view members and update member roles

entities.name: project
relationships: a project owner references one member
a project creator references one authenticated user

entities.name: task
relationships: a task belongs to one project
a task owner references one member
a task creator references one authenticated user

entities.name: member
relationships: a member maps to one authenticated platform user

entities.name: taskFilter
relationships: taskFilter reads task rows and member rows but is not persisted

entities.name: analyticsSummary
relationships: analyticsSummary is calculated from durable project and task rows and is not persisted

auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: signed-out visitors are redirected to /login when opening any dashboard route
authenticated members can read shared Alder Studio projects, tasks, and member display information
authenticated members can create projects and tasks
authenticated members can update task status and task owner
only administrators can open /admin and update member roles
non-administrator members see Access denied on /admin and cannot see role editing controls

operations.description: persist a new project via db.entity('project').create
update saved project fields via db.entity('project').update
persist a new task under a project via db.entity('task').create
update the status of an existing task via db.entity('task').update
update the owner of an existing task via db.entity('task').update
return matching tasks for board and list views from current transient filter controls

responsibilities.behavior: match saved tasks by search text, selected status, and selected owner; all-statuses and all-owners are all-options sentinels

operations.description: calculate visible analytics metrics from durable project and task data

responsibilities.behavior: count projects and tasks, count tasks by status, count overdue incomplete tasks using due dates, and calculate completion rate

operations.description: administrator updates a member role via db.entity('member').update

integrations.name: backend auth
integrations.purpose: authenticate Alder Studio members with platform auth.currentUser, signIn, and signOut

integrations.name: backend database
integrations.purpose: persist projects, tasks, and member roles with db.entity CRUD

states.empty: no dashboard content until authentication completes
states.validation: email and password are required on the sign-in form
states.error: sign in failed, check your credentials
states.success: signed in navigation shows Projects, Board, Tasks, Analytics, and Sign out

states.loading: project list skeleton while projects load
states.empty: No projects yet. Create your first Alder Studio project.
states.validation: project title, client name, owner, target date, and status are required
states.error: project could not be saved, try again

states.loading: project and task skeleton while records load
states.empty: No tasks yet for this project
states.validation: task title, owner, priority, due date, and status are required
states.error: task change could not be saved, try again

states.loading: board columns show loading placeholders while tasks load
states.empty: No tasks match the current filters
states.validation: filter selections must use available status and member options
states.success: visible filter summary shows active status and owner filters

states.validation: search text may be blank or any visible text
states.error: task list could not be loaded

states.loading: metric cards show loading placeholders while summary is calculated
states.validation: analytics uses saved project and task rows only
states.success: metric cards and status breakdown are visible

states.loading: members table skeleton while members load
states.validation: role must be Member or Administrator

acceptance.statement: a signed-out visitor opening /projects is redirected to /login or shown a sign-in form instead of dashboard data
a submitted project is visible in the project list after a full page reload
a submitted task is visible under its project after a full page reload
changing a task status to In Progress remains visible after a full page reload
board filters show only tasks matching the selected status and owner and display an active filter summary
task list search for Kickoff shows matching rows and hides non-matching rows
analytics displays numeric total projects, total tasks, completed tasks, blocked tasks, overdue tasks, and completion rate metrics
a non-administrator opening /admin sees Access denied and no role editing controls
an administrator role change for a member remains visible after a full page reload

deferred.item: time tracking and billable hour reporting
deferred.reason: the request asks for project and task operations, filtering, and analytics summary, not timesheets
the request does not require uploading or managing project files
the fixed scaffold allows backend SDK capabilities only and the request does not require external integrations
the request specifies member and administrator roles, not custom access rules per project
